entries.question: What is one of the benefits of using alert automation in Service Operations Workspace?

options.A: It offers a simplified experience for creating and managing event and alert related rules
options.B: It uses back end tables separate from those in event management rules
options.C: It enables centralized administration for all alert management
options.D: It does not require any knowledge of the source event collection tool

entries.question: When setting up a monitoring connector definition PULL the M.0 Server must be validated and have Line of Sight (LoS) to the monitoring system. This configuration requires what? Choose 4 answers

options.A: Polling interval for scheduling access to the target system
options.B: Internal IP address and port for communication with the target System
options.C: An active and validated MID Server
options.D: Access credentials la the MID Server system
options.E: Internal IP address and port for communication with the MID Server system
options.F: Access credentials lo the monitoring system
